IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'MyAdlsBlob')
BEGIN
  CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE MyAdlsBlob
  WITH (
    LOCATION = 'https://dotpladlsv2.blob.core.windows.net/synapsecontainer'
  );
END


-- 4) (Optional) Create a parquet file format - useful for CETAS
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'ParquetFileFormat')
BEGIN
  CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT ParquetFileFormat
  WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET
  );
END


IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.booking_aggregates_ext') IS NOT NULL
  DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.booking_aggregates_ext;


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.booking_aggregates_ext
WITH (
  LOCATION = 'aggregates/Indecab_Network_Requests_Agg/@{pipeline().RunId}/',   -- relative to container root
  DATA_SOURCE = MyAdlsBlob,
  FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFileFormat
)
AS
SELECT
  COALESCE(fromCity, '(NULL)') AS fromCity,
  event_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_events,
  SYSUTCDATETIME() AS agg_run_utc
FROM
  OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'Staging/ITH/Indecab_Dashboard/*.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'MyAdlsBlob',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
  ) WITH (
    PK_ID BIGINT,
    event_id VARCHAR(200),
    event_name VARCHAR(500),
    _id VARCHAR(200),
    fromCity VARCHAR(200),
    toCity VARCHAR(200)
  ) AS rows
GROUP BY COALESCE(fromCity, '(NULL)'), event_name;


-- 7) Verify the CETAS output by reading the generated parquet files
SELECT TOP (20) *
FROM OPENROWSET(
  BULK 'https://dotpladlsv2.blob.core.windows.net/synapsecontainer/aggregates/Indecab_Network_Requests_Agg/*.parquet',
  FORMAT='PARQUET'
) AS t;
